jobs.occupation: Truck Driver with   CE License  &  Warehouse Worker (M/F/X)       –    2 shifts     –       Brussels
jobs.description:
We are looking for a versatile CE driver & warehouse worker (M/F/X) to join the team of a well-known employer in Zaventem. In addition to driving the lorry between the two warehouses (distance of approximately 12 kilometres), you will also work as a warehouse worker and be deployed in a multifunctional role.
 

Performing the job correctly contributes to good results and a stronger team. That is why flexibility, eagerness to learn, common sense and stress resistance are essential. Do you have an ETP certificate or a forklift certificate? That is a plus, but not a requirement.

 

• You are stress-resistant, accurate and able to stay focused. 

• You are a team player. 

• You are flexible and motivated. 

• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus! 

• You can easily travel to work. 

• You have the ability to work in a rotating two-shift system. 

• You have a CE driving licence.

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You have a valid CE driver’s license and a valid driver card

• You have experience as a CE driver, preferably with completing transport documents

• You speak and understand communicative English

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You work accurately and appreciate clear agreements

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)

jobs.occupation: Experienced Vehicle Technician Wanted – Automotive Maintenance Specialist Rumst
jobs.description:
As a vehicle technician, you are responsible for the maintenance and repair of passenger cars and light commercial vehicles of all makes. You will work in a spacious, modern body shop known for its craftsmanship and customer focus. The workshop specializes in both conventional and electric/hybrid vehicles, so you'll work with the latest automotive technologies.

On a typical day, you’ll independently carry out both minor and major maintenance services. You diagnose technical issues using state-of-the-art diagnostic tools and perform mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs. Quality is key, and you ensure every vehicle leaves the workshop in top condition.

Are you a precise, self-reliant technician with a passion for cars? Apply now and become part of a dedicated team. Together, you’ll ensure satisfied customers and vehicles in perfect working order.

• Diploma in automotive technology at secondary education level or equivalent through experience

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a car technician

• Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and systems

• Able to work independently and accurately

• Proficient in English, both spoken and written

• Holder of a valid category B driver’s license

• Passion for vehicles and new technologies

Are you ready to take the next step in your career as a Technical Operator? As a vital member of our team, you'll work with cutting-edge machinery to produce high-quality steel profiles. You'll become an expert in operating our state-of-the-art equipment, ensuring that production runs smoothly and efficiently.

Every day, you'll engage with complex and simple finishing machines including conventional and CNC-controlled systems like sawing machines, drilling machines, and laser cutters. Your keen attention to detail and commitment to quality will ensure that every component meets our high standards.

We're looking for motivated and eager-to-learn individuals. Apply now to join a supportive environment where your skills will be valued and developed!

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience

• Proficiency in reading and executing mechanical diagrams

• Fluency in English

• Knowledge of pneumatics and ability to install tubes and test movements

• Passion for technology and a team-oriented mindset

• Eagerness to learn with a conscientious and responsible approach

• Strict adherence to safety rules and flexibility in working hours

Are you looking to kickstart your career in construction? Join us as a General Construction Worker where every day is a new opportunity to make a tangible impact. You'll be working on varied projects, gaining hands-on experience in demolition, masonry, insulation, and more. 

Your typical day will be dynamic and rewarding. You'll assist skilled workers, ensure site safety, and help maintain project flow. Your contribution is critical in creating structures that stand strong and look impressive. 

Ready to put your skills to the test and grow with us? Apply today and be part of a team that values your effort and dedication.

• Experience in construction (minimum one year)

• Communicative English skills

• Physically fit and hardworking

• Motivated to learn and grow in construction

• Flexible and hands-on attitude

• Own transportation (a plus)

• VCA certificate

Step into a role that molds the very foundation of tomorrow's structures. As a Concrete Worker, you play a crucial role in preparing, placing, and finishing concrete for various structural projects. Work with a dedicated team to bring blueprints to life, ensuring that every measure is executed to perfection.

Picture your day starting with a collaborative briefing with your team, followed by hands-on work where you prepare formwork, place and finish concrete, and ensure every detail aligns with design specifications. You will be reading construction plans, placing reinforcements, and ensuring site cleanliness, all while maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

Are you ready to take your construction career to the next level? If you are motivated, physically fit, and willing to learn, we want you! Apply now and become a part of a team that values skill and dedication.

• At least 1 year of experience in construction

• Ability to read construction drawings

• Communicative English

• Physically fit and hardworking

• Motivated to learn and grow

• Flexible and hands-on attitude

• Own transportation is a plus

• VCA certificate or willingness to obtain one

As a Pistol Painter, you'll play a crucial role in our vibrant team, ensuring every vehicle part meets our high-quality standards. You'll be responsible for preparing parts, mixing paint, and applying it with precision. Your keen eye for detail will ensure that every vehicle leaves our facility looking its best.

Your day will be hands-on from start to finish. Begin with checking parts for assembly, then move on to sanding, degreasing, and masking. You'll mix paint in our state-of-the-art lab, spray it on truck bodies, and conduct thorough final inspections to ensure perfection.

Ready to bring your painting skills to life in a dynamic work setting? Apply today and contribute to a team that values quality and craftsmanship!

• Eye for detail and color precision
• Experience as a repairer/painter
• Fluent in English
• Strong communication skills and teamwork ability
• Passion for technique and craftsmanship
• Valid driving license B

This large Belgian organization manages a technically complex and business-critical network where operational safety, real-time communication and system reliability are essential. Behind the scenes, several digital platforms support field operations, control rooms and operational staff in managing safety-critical processes.
Within this context, one of the core applications is evolving from a single solution into a broader ecosystem of applications focused on the safety of real-time operations. To support this evolution, the organization is looking for an experienced Architect who can bring structure, technical vision and architectural leadership to the team.

You will define and guide the technical architecture of a growing application ecosystem used in safety-critical operational processes. You will work closely with developers, analysts, product stakeholders and technical teams to ensure that new and existing solutions are scalable, reliable and future-proof.
You will use your expertise to assess current implementations, propose improvements and help shape upcoming developments. You will coach developers, promote best practices and ensure that architectural decisions are translated into clean, maintainable and robust solutions.
You will also proactively identify technical risks, challenge implementation choices where needed and ensure that quality, scope and deadlines remain aligned. Because the applications support real-time operational workflows, performance, stability and clear communication are crucial throughout your mission.

The ATE Test Development Engineer is responsible for the ATE test implementation and optimization making use of our ATE test setup. From the initial ASIC development kick-off until end of life, the ATE Test Development Engineer will be responsible for defining ATE test software and supporting the launch of new products into high volume production. Together with the test engineers in our bench test lab, the ATE Test Development Engineer keeps a clear overview, ensuring a strong overall test methodology. This position is part of the product engineering group of ICsense and cooperates with cross-functional teams of Test engineers, Design (DFT), Product Engineering, Reliability, Foundry.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Responsible for the implementation and performance of production tests of ICsense ASICs, taking into account quality and test performance 
 

• Set up, implementation, debug and optimization of test programs for automated testing 

• Work with ICsense test engineers to correlate bench test results and ATE test results for debug, characterization, … 

• Ensure the test program is scalable (multi-site), re-usable and accurate (GR&R)   

• Drive continuous improvements to product quality and customer satisfaction throughout the lifecycle of the product 
 

• Investigate ATE test setup related problems, find the root cause and propose ATE test setup/software adaptations to the project team to overcome these problems 

• Work on yield improvement/test time reduction programs together with the product quality team   

Competencies
 
 

• You have a Master degree in Industrial engineering 

• You have knowledge of test methodologies and equipment to ensure proper testing of ASICs 

• Experience with ATE test development is an asset (internal training will be provided) 

• Experience with one of the main ATE programming languages is required: VBA, C++ or Java 

• Experience with Prober set-up and handling is a strong plus 

• Team player with a strong sense of urgency to meet test requirements on schedule 

• You communicate fluently in English (oral and written)

The Talent Acquisition Specialist joins the HR / Talent Acquisition team supporting Fuel Cells & Stationary Catalysis activities at the Bayport (Pasadena, TX) site within a broader North American manufacturing and commercial environment.

In this role, you oversee the full recruitment cycle for professional, technical and specialist vacancies, with a strong focus on office profiles such as Finance, HR and management, as well as technical white-collar and blue-collar profiles.

• Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for the assigned scope.
• Partner with hiring managers to organize intake meetings, define candidate profiles, align on priorities and set realistic timelines.
• Develop and implement sourcing strategies through LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards and other relevant channels.
• Actively build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring or business-critical positions.
• Conduct screening interviews and evaluate candidates based on experience, skills and overall fit for the role and environment.
• Coordinate the interview process with hiring teams, including scheduling and feedback follow-up.
• Advise stakeholders on market insights and compensation positioning throughout the hiring process.
• Help ensure a professional and positive candidate experience at every stage.
• Maintain accurate recruitment records and candidate data in the ATS.
• Track recruitment KPIs such as time-to-fill, time-to-hire and pipeline conversion, and provide regular progress updates.
• Work in line with internal procedures and applicable US federal, Texas state and local employment regulations.
Location

Bayport / Pasadena, Texas.

Hybrid working model with approximately 2 to 3 on-site days per week; additional on-site presence may be requested during the first months.

• You bring proven experience in full-cycle talent acquisition, ideally in a corporate or international environment.
• Talent acquisition is a core strength, including autonomous management of multiple open requisitions at the same time.
• You have strong direct sourcing and headhunting experience, including Boolean search and passive-candidate outreach.
• You have experience recruiting office profiles such as Finance, HR and management functions.
• You also have experience hiring technical white-collar and blue-collar profiles, ideally in a manufacturing or industrial setting.
• You are comfortable working with ATS platforms and LinkedIn Recruiter.
• You understand compliant recruitment practices and have working knowledge of US employment law, including EEO and ADA principles.
• You communicate clearly, conduct strong candidate assessments and build effective relationships with hiring managers and leaders at different levels.
• You are well organized, able to work independently and comfortable in a fast-paced, international and matrixed environment.
• You are adaptable and resilient in a changing business context.
• Fluent English is required; other languages are an asset.

jobs.occupation: Scrum Master - Master of the subject - Financial Services
jobs.description:
SENIOR SCRUM MASTER - Masterize the subject - Brussels

This is not a classic Scrum Master position focused solely on ceremonies and Agile rituals.

You will take a senior, hands-on role within a large Agile environment, with responsibility for improving processes, challenging existing ways of working and bringing real added value through your expertise.

Being Senior means going beyond what is asked of you: taking ownership, identifying opportunities for improvement, making recommendations and actively contributing to better ways of working.

A key part of the role will also be budget follow-up and financial tracking, a responsibility that typically sits with a Project Manager.

You will work closely with Squad Leads and stakeholders to improve team effectiveness and delivery performance.

Senior Scrum Master - the job:

You will…

• Drive Agile practices while challenging and continuously improving processes, ways of working and team effectiveness.
• Take ownership of budget follow-up and financial tracking, alongside the usual Scrum Master responsibilities.
• Coach and support teams and stakeholders, going beyond facilitation to bring your own expertise and proactively improve delivery.

Senior Scrum Master - your profile:

You are/have…

• Strong Senior Scrum Master experience, with a proven ability to go beyond ceremonies and proactively improve processes.
• A solid understanding of IT development lifecycles, including design, development and testing.
• A genuine Senior mindset: you take ownership, challenge the status quo and bring added value through your expertise.
• A hands-on, communicative and flexible personality, with a strong team spirit and a constructive approach to compromise.
• Fluent English.

Our client is an engineering company.

1. IT Infrastructure Governance & Strategy

• Assess business and end-user needs, as well as quality, operational, and security requirements.
• Translate business requirements into IT solutions and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Design, maintain, and continuously improve the local IT infrastructure architecture in alignment with business objectives and Group standards.
• Advise management on IT strategy, technology evolution, infrastructure investments, and risk mitigation.
• Monitor emerging technologies and recommend improvements to systems, services, and operational efficiency.
• Ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, licensing, and corporate requirements.

2. User Support & Service Delivery

• Provide technical support to end-users through telephone, e-mail, remote assistance, and face-to-face interventions.
• Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and system-related issues.
• Assist end-users in the effective use of IT equipment, systems, and applications.
• Deliver user guidance and training when required.
• Coordinate with external providers and Group IT teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
• Coordinate with external providers and Group IT teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
• Document support procedures and maintain an up-to-date knowledge base.

3. Infrastructure Operations & Maintenance

• Design, implement, operate, and maintain local IT infrastructure including servers, networks, endpoints, and associated services.
• Ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of IT systems and infrastructure.
• Manage backup, recovery, monitoring, and business continuity mechanisms.
• Perform infrastructure updates, upgrades, patch management, and corrective maintenance activities.
• Maintain accurate technical documentation, inventory records, system configurations, and operational procedures.
• Ensure the smooth operation of all IT services, including network services, endpoint management, printing services, e-mail systems, and security tools.

4. Cybersecurity & Compliance

• Support the development, implementation, maintenance, and monitoring of the cybersecurity policies, procedures, and controls in accordance with legal, regulatory, customer, and Group requirements.
• Continuously assess and improve the security posture of systems, applications, and infrastructure.
• Ensure the effective operation of security solutions, including endpoint protection, access control, monitoring, backup, and recovery systems.
• Contribute to security audits, compliance assessments, and corrective action plans.
• Participate in the management of cybersecurity incidents and crisis situations involving complex infrastructure or software issues.

Profile

• A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
• A minimum of five years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or a comparable role.
• Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Windows environments, Microsoft 365, Active Directory or Entra ID, networking, endpoint management, backup and recovery, virtualization, and infrastructure monitoring.
• Practical knowledge of cybersecurity controls, vulnerability and patch management, access control, endpoint protection, incident response, and secure infrastructure configuration.
• Experience providing remote and on-site end-user support and managing incidents, service requests, technical documentation, and SLAs.
• Experience managing IT suppliers, licenses, assets, procurement activities, and budget-related processes.
• Experience with ISO 27001 implementation is a strong plus.
• Proven ability to operate independently as a local IT point of contact while collaborating effectively with centralised Group IT functions.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder-management, and organisational skills.
• Professional fluency in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an advantage.
• Willingness to participate in an on-call rota and provide support outside standard working hours when required.
• Relevant Microsoft, networking, ITIL, or cybersecurity certifications are considered an advantage.
